app.name: Fing Network Monitor
app.description: Track network device presence and detect unknown devices using your Fingbox.

fingbox.name: Fingbox
fingbox.description: Your Fingbox hardware unit. Acts as the hub for all network device monitoring.

network_device.name: Network Device
network_device.description: A network device tracked by Fing. Provides presence detection and IP address monitoring.

start.title: Connect your Fingbox
start.body:
You will need the IP address, port (default 49090), and API key from the Fing app.

To find your API key: open the Fing app → Fingbox → Settings → Local API → Enable and copy the key.

credentials.title: Enter Fingbox Details
credentials.hint_ip: Local IP address of your Fingbox
credentials.placeholder_key: Paste your Fing Local API key
credentials.hint_key: Find this in the Fing app: Fingbox → Settings → Local API

error.missing_fields: Please enter an IP address and API key.
error.connect_error: Could not connect to Fingbox. Check the IP address and port, and make sure the Fingbox is online.
error.timeout: Connection timed out. Check that the Fingbox is powered on and reachable.
error.invalid_key: Invalid API key. Check the key in the Fing app under Fingbox → Settings → Local API.
error.no_credentials: No connection details available. Please go back and enter your Fingbox credentials.

error.no_fingbox: Please add your Fingbox first before adding network devices.
error.fingbox_offline: Fingbox is currently unreachable. Please check connectivity and try again.
error.fetch_failed: Failed to fetch device list from Fingbox.
error.no_devices: No devices found on your Fing network. Make sure Fing has scanned your network recently.
error.all_paired: All Fing-tracked devices are already added to Homey. You can add more when new devices appear on your network.

poll_interval.label: Poll Interval (seconds)
poll_interval.hint: How often to check your Fingbox for device updates. Min: 10, Max: 300. Default: 30.
poll_interval.error_range: Poll interval must be between 10 and 300 seconds.

new_unknown_device.title: An unknown device appeared on the network
